raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Add M3.1-Flash multimodal input handling and public-checkpoint-layout full-weight export to the **VeOmni training / vLLM rollout** path. This enables the full-parameter M3.1-Flash integration without adding generic LoRA support.

The target checkpoint is **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash**. Its checkpoint config uses `model_type="minimax_m3_vl"` and architecture `MiniMaxM3SparseForConditionalGeneration`; existing `minimax_m3` module/class identifiers are retained for compatibility. They are architecture identifiers, not a claim that a different model version was validated.

Model dimensions and dense/MoE schedules come from config. Export validates EP ownership and streams expert rows; vision/projector and fused dense/expert keys map to the public layout. Image placeholders are collapsed before vLLM expansion, and the expanded inference prompt is checked against the training token sequence.

### Why this is not duplicate work

Searched open [MiniMax PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+MiniMax) and [VeOmni LoRA PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+VeOmni+LoRA) on 2026-10-28. #8353 uses verl-native FSDP2 for a text model; this is the VeOmni multimodal route. [VeOmni #1315](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/pull/1315) provides the model but explicitly lacks rollout-layout export. #8307 supplies generic dense LoRA and is not included here; its checkpoint import compatibility pattern is acknowledged.

### Test

- Ported to main `2ab35292039a51175a4b3d3b3b2d76e951a0d3e4`, preserving its newer vLLM admission helper and VeOmni engine changes.
- **30 CPU cases passed again (4.84s)**: tensor-name/shape contracts, image-span normalization, and two-process Gloo expert-row export.
- Public-layout inverse check: all **23,416 public keys / 1,582 native parameters**, with full 60-layer / 128-expert / 32-vision-layer key layout and reduced matrix sizes, round-trip exactly, including shuffled input order. This is a layout check, not full-model allocation or training.
- Scoped Ruff lint/format and `bash -n examples/grpo_trainer/run_minimax_m3_veomni.sh` pass.
- CPU command: `python -m pytest --noconftest -o addopts= -q tests`, with plugin autoload disabled, on an isolated task-owned source snapshot and existing Python 3.12 server packages.
- The helper tests do not import or run the complete Ray/vLLM/VeOmni stack. No new hardware run, standard repository conftest/scheduler run, or full-repository pre-commit is claimed for this port.

### Historical full-model evidence

The experimental stack used the complete **60-layer / 128-expert M3.1-Flash**, with **16 nodes / 256 NPUs**, training EP32/SP1 and rollout EP64. It completed two actor updates and weight synchronizations. Reward was 0.6476563 then 0.7145833; gradient norms were 0.2054841 and 0.2149987. DSpark was disabled.

This is historical evidence from the experimental stack, not a fresh run of this extracted branch. Train/evaluation used the same 500 examples; the driver later exited nonzero and no checkpoint was produced. It does not establish generalization, long-run stability, or an SFT result.

### Dependency and reproduction

The model/base operators originate from VeOmni #1315. A publicly addressable integration source is now available:

```bash
uv pip install --no-deps 'veomni @ git+https://github.com/Li-Jicheng/VeOmni.git@d51ffd7ca60b65be361091c2f3c95828772262ef'
```

Use this only inside a compatible VeOmni/verl environment; --no-deps does not resolve the rest of the stack. This is a fixed integration revision, not a released package. Its source includes #1315, a pinned dense-reference dependency from VeOmni #1337, and expert-LoRA work used by the separate LoRA follow-up; this full-weight PR does not require that generic verl LoRA follow-up.

**Draft acceptance:** this PR intentionally does not replace verl's global VeOmni install pin or claim its current uv.lock resolves this integration. Final dependency selection and lock regeneration/validation remain required before merge. The companion upstream PR is [VeOmni #1380](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/pull/1380); the fixed source commit above remains the reproducible integration reference.

### Checklist before submission / requesting merge

- [x] Human reviewed the original changed code, understands it and attested relevant tests on 2026-10-28.
- [x] Source delta reapplied to current main; scoped CPU/Ruff/bash checks passed.
- [x] Exact combined VeOmni source commit published and linked.
- [ ] Final supported dependency pin and regenerated/validated uv.lock.
- [ ] Full repository pre-commit on a resolved checkout.
- [ ] Accelerator/FSDP2/EP acceptance of the published combination.
- [ ] Maintainer CI request.

Human review checkmarks record the submitting user's confirmation; other checks state their actual execution scope. AI assistance was used for source adaptation, tests, review and PR preparation.

@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+MiniMax M3 with VeOmni and vLLM
+==============================
+
+This integration exports the unquantized ``minimax_m3_vl`` model from VeOmni's
+training layout into the public checkpoint layout consumed by vLLM. Dimensions
+and dense/MoE schedules come from the model config. It normalizes image
+placeholders before vLLM processor expansion and checks the expanded prompt.
+
+Dependencies
+------------
+
+The model and base SwiGLU-OAI operators currently require `VeOmni PR #1315
+<https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/pull/1315>`_, inspected at
+``3fc30d7f306aa086e16859622b0369eab454f8df``. This is an unmerged source
+dependency, not a released PyPI version. The verl integration is based on
+``4d3ed12a7617c6b78ee0ac8f27dd7848bb0d11ee``. An exact combined VeOmni commit
+must be published and recorded before this integration can be installed with a
+frozen dependency lock; the existing default VeOmni pin is insufficient.
+
+Use a vLLM/vllm-ascend build with matching MiniMax M3 public-layout support.
+Record its commit, PyTorch, torch-npu and CANN versions as well as Python
+package versions. A conda package list alone does not identify editable source
+copies, import paths or native runtime libraries. No particular current
+vLLM/vllm-ascend pair is newly hardware-validated by this change.
+
+Usage
+-----
+
+``examples/grpo_trainer/run_minimax_m3_veomni.sh`` is an Ascend integration
+template. Supply ``MODEL_PATH``, ``TRAIN_FILES``, ``VAL_FILES``, ``NNODES``,
+``NPUS_PER_NODE``, ``TRAIN_EP``, ``TRAIN_SP``, ``ROLLOUT_TP`` and ``ROLLOUT_EP``
+for a prepared Ray cluster. The script uses full weight synchronization and
+eager rollout. Extra Hydra overrides are accepted at the end. It does not
+provision machines or install dependencies, and the new template has only been
+syntax-checked; size its batch and topology for the complete model.
+
+Validation boundaries
+---------------------
+
+CPU tests cover public tensor names/shapes, image tokens and two-process Gloo
+expert-row export. These tests need no model weights or accelerators. They do
+not establish NPU kernel behavior, full-model memory use or numerical training
+equivalence on the extracted source.
+
+Historical full-size M3.1-Flash evidence used 60 layers and 128 experts on
+16 machines/256 NPUs: training EP32/SP1 and rollout EP64, with DSpark disabled.
+It completed two actor updates and synchronizations. Rewards were 0.6476563
+and 0.7145833 on a shared 500-example training/evaluation set. The later driver
+exit was nonzero and there was no saved checkpoint. This is historical
+integration evidence, not a test of the new source or a long-run quality claim.
+
+Quantized checkpoints, MTP, adapter-only/delta synchronization and resumability
+are outside this full-parameter change. No SFT result is inferred from RL logs.

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Ascend integration template; source dependencies and capacity must be prepared.
+set -euo pipefail
+: "${MODEL_PATH:?Set the unquantized full-size MiniMax M3 checkpoint path}"
+: "${TRAIN_FILES:?Set a prepared training parquet file}"
+: "${VAL_FILES:?Set a prepared validation parquet file}"
+: "${NNODES:?Set the prepared Ray cluster node count}"
+: "${NPUS_PER_NODE:?Set NPUs per node}"
+: "${TRAIN_EP:?Set training expert parallel size}"
+: "${TRAIN_SP:?Set training sequence parallel size}"
+: "${ROLLOUT_TP:?Set rollout tensor parallel size}"
+: "${ROLLOUT_EP:?Set rollout expert parallel size}"
+
+python -m verl.trainer.main_ppo --config-path=./config --config-name=ppo_trainer \
+    model_engine=veomni algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo \
+    "data.train_files=$TRAIN_FILES" "data.val_files=$VAL_FILES" \
+    data.train_batch_size=16 data.max_prompt_length=1024 data.max_response_length=1024 \
+    data.image_key=images data.filter_overlong_prompts=True data.truncation=error \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.model.path=$MODEL_PATH" actor_rollout_ref.model.lora_rank=0 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=16 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=True actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_torch_compile=False \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.veomni.mixed_precision=True \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.actor.veomni.expert_parallel_size=$TRAIN_EP" \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.actor.veomni.ulysses_parallel_size=$TRAIN_SP" \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.veomni.attn_implementation=flash_attention_2 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.veomni.moe_implementation=fused_npu \
+    actor_rollout_ref.ref.strategy=veomni actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.ref.veomni.expert_parallel_size=$TRAIN_EP" \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.ref.veomni.ulysses_parallel_size=$TRAIN_SP" \
+    actor_rollout_ref.ref.veomni.attn_implementation=flash_attention_2 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.ref.veomni.moe_implementation=fused_npu \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=8 \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=$ROLLOUT_TP" \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.expert_parallel_size=$ROLLOUT_EP" \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enforce_eager=True actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enable_prefix_caching=False \
+    "trainer.nnodes=$NNODES" "trainer.n_gpus_per_node=$NPUS_PER_NODE" \
+    trainer.logger='[console]' trainer.project_name=minimax-m3-veomni \
+    trainer.experiment_name=integration-template trainer.total_training_steps=2 \
+    trainer.save_freq=-1 trainer.test_freq=1 trainer.resume_mode=disable "$@"

+# Copyright 2026 verl contributors
+# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
+"""Check public MiniMax export values, model dimensions and EP row ownership."""
+
+import importlib.util
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "verl/workers/engine/veomni/m3_weight_export.py"
+_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m3_weight_export_contract", _PATH)
+m3 = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
+sys.modules[_SPEC.name] = m3
+_SPEC.loader.exec_module(m3)
+
+
+def config(**overrides):
+    text = dict(
+        num_hidden_layers=2,
+        num_local_experts=4,
+        hidden_size=3,
+        intermediate_size=2,
+        dense_intermediate_size=5,
+        shared_intermediate_size=2,
+        moe_layer_freq=[0, 1],
+    )
+    text.update(overrides)
+    return dict(text_config=text, vision_config=dict(num_hidden_layers=2))
+
+
+def test_expert_gate_up_exports_public_weights_with_correct_expert_ids():
+    spec = m3.M3ExportSpec.from_config(config())
+    source = torch.arange(24.0).reshape(2, 4, 3)
+    before = source.clone()
+    out = dict(
+        m3.export_m3_tensor("model.language_model.layers.1.mlp.experts.gate_up_proj", source, spec, expert_id_base=2)
+    )
+    for row, expert in enumerate((2, 3)):
+        prefix = f"language_model.model.layers.1.block_sparse_moe.experts.{expert}."
+        assert torch.equal(out[prefix + "w1.weight"], source[row, :2])
+        assert torch.equal(out[prefix + "w3.weight"], source[row, 2:])
+    assert torch.equal(source, before)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "name,target,shape",
+    [
+        ("lm_head.weight", "language_model.lm_head.weight", (7, 3)),
+        ("model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight", "language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight", (7, 3)),
+        (
+            "model.language_model.layers.1.self_attn.indexer.k_norm.weight",
+            "language_model.model.layers.1.self_attn.index_k_norm.weight",
+            (3,),
+        ),
+        (
+            "model.language_model.layers.1.mlp.experts.down_proj",
+            "language_model.model.layers.1.block_sparse_moe.experts.0.w2.weight",
+            (4, 3, 2),
+        ),
+        (
+            "model.vision_tower.embeddings.proj.weight",
+            "vision_tower.vision_model.embeddings.patch_embedding.weight",
+            (3, 3),
+        ),
+        (
+            "model.vision_tower.layers.1.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
+            "vision_tower.vision_model.encoder.layers.1.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
+            (3, 3),
+        ),
+        ("model.multi_modal_projector.merge_linear_1.weight", "patch_merge_mlp.linear_1.weight", (3, 3)),
+    ],
+)
+def test_plain_vision_projector_and_expert_mappings(name, target, shape):
+    source = torch.randn(shape)
+    out = dict(m3.export_m3_tensor(name, source, m3.M3ExportSpec.from_config(config())))
+    assert target in out
+    expected = source[0] if "experts.down_proj" in name else source
+    assert torch.equal(out[target], expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layer,shared,width", [(0, False, 5), (1, True, 2)])
+def test_dense_and_shared_dimensions_are_independent(layer, shared, width):
+    name = f"model.language_model.layers.{layer}.mlp." + ("shared_experts." if shared else "")
+    source = torch.randn(2 * width, 3)
+    out = list(m3.export_m3_tensor(name + "gate_up_proj.weight", source, m3.M3ExportSpec.from_config(config())))
+    assert len(out) == 2
+    assert out[0][0].endswith("gate_proj.weight")
+    assert out[1][0].endswith("up_proj.weight")
+    assert torch.equal(torch.cat([pair[1] for pair in out]), source)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "name,shape",
+    [
+        ("model.language_model.layers.2.input_layernorm.weight", (3,)),
+        ("model.language_model.layers.0.mlp.experts.down_proj", (4, 3, 2)),
+        ("model.language_model.layers.1.mlp.gate.weight", (3, 3)),
+        ("model.language_model.layers.1.mlp.experts.gate_up_proj", (4, 3, 3)),
+        ("model.vision_tower.layers.2.self_attn.q_proj.weight", (3, 3)),
+        ("unknown.weight", (3,)),
+    ],
+)
+def test_invalid_layouts_fail_before_sending_weights(name, shape):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        list(m3.export_m3_tensor(name, torch.zeros(shape), m3.M3ExportSpec.from_config(config())))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "overrides",
+    [
+        dict(num_local_experts=0),
+        dict(dense_intermediate_size=0),
+        dict(moe_layer_freq=[1]),
+        dict(mlp_layer_types=["unknown", "sparse"]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_invalid_model_configuration_is_rejected(overrides):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        m3.M3ExportSpec.from_config(config(**overrides))
+
+
+def test_quantized_configuration_and_integer_state_are_rejected():
+    cfg = config()
+    cfg["quantization_config"] = dict(quant_method="fp8")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unquantized"):
+        m3.M3ExportSpec.from_config(cfg)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="non-floating"):
+        list(
+            m3.export_m3_tensor(
+                "lm_head.weight", torch.zeros(3, dtype=torch.int32), m3.M3ExportSpec.from_config(config())
+            )
+        )
+
+
+def _ep_worker(rank, rendezvous):
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    dist.init_process_group("gloo", init_method=rendezvous, rank=rank, world_size=2)
+    try:
+        spec = m3.M3ExportSpec.from_config(config())
+        state = SimpleNamespace(ep_enabled=True, ep_size=2, ep_rank=rank, ep_group=dist.group.WORLD)
+        source = torch.stack([torch.full((4, 3), float(2 * rank + i)) for i in range(2)])
+        before = source.clone()
+        values = dict(m3.iter_m3_param("model.language_model.layers.1.mlp.experts.gate_up_proj", source, spec, state))
+        for expert in range(4):

+            for projection in ("w1", "w3"):
+                assert torch.equal(values[prefix + projection + ".weight"], torch.full((2, 3), float(expert)))
+        assert torch.equal(source, before)
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()

+"""Export VeOmni MiniMax M3 tensors in the public checkpoint layout.
+
+The inverse of VeOmni's MiniMax public-layout checkpoint import converter.
+No layer count, expert count, hidden size, or vision depth is hard-coded.
+Only full floating-point weight transfer is supported; this is not a quantizer.
+"""
+
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+
+def _get(config, name, default=None):
+    return config.get(name, default) if isinstance(config, Mapping) else getattr(config, name, default)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class M3ExportSpec:
+    layers: int
+    experts: int
+    hidden: int
+    intermediate: int
+    dense_intermediate: int
+    shared_intermediate: int
+    moe_layers: tuple[bool, ...]
+    vision_layers: int
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_config(cls, config):
+        text = _get(config, "text_config", config)
+        if _get(config, "quantization_config") or _get(text, "quantization_config"):
+            raise ValueError("M3 RL export currently requires an unquantized checkpoint")
+        layers = int(_get(text, "num_hidden_layers"))
+        kinds = _get(text, "mlp_layer_types")
+        if kinds is not None:
+            if any(k not in ("sparse", "dense") for k in kinds):
+                raise ValueError("Unknown M3 mlp_layer_types")
+            moe = tuple(k == "sparse" for k in kinds)
+        else:
+            frequency = _get(text, "moe_layer_freq")
+            moe = tuple(bool(x) for x in frequency) if frequency is not None else (True,) * layers
+        if len(moe) != layers:
+            raise ValueError("M3 MoE layer schedule length must equal num_hidden_layers")
+        intermediate = int(_get(text, "intermediate_size"))
+        result = cls(
+            layers=layers,
+            experts=int(_get(text, "num_local_experts", _get(text, "num_experts"))),
+            hidden=int(_get(text, "hidden_size")),
+            intermediate=intermediate,
+            dense_intermediate=int(_get(text, "dense_intermediate_size", intermediate)),
+            shared_intermediate=int(_get(text, "shared_intermediate_size", intermediate)),
+            moe_layers=moe,
+            vision_layers=int(_get(_get(config, "vision_config", {}), "num_hidden_layers", 0)),
+        )
+        if (
+            min(
+                result.layers,
+                result.experts,
+                result.hidden,
+                result.intermediate,
+                result.dense_intermediate,
+                result.shared_intermediate,
+            )
+            < 1
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("M3 dimensions must be positive")
+        if result.vision_layers < 0:
+            raise ValueError("M3 vision depth must be nonnegative")
+        return result
+
+
+_LAYER = re.compile(r"^model\.language_model\.layers\.(\d+)\.(.+)$")
+_EXPERT = re.compile(r"^mlp\.experts\.(gate_up_proj|down_proj)$")
+
+
+def _check_shape(name, tensor, expected):
+    if tuple(tensor.shape) != tuple(expected):
+        raise ValueError(f"M3 export shape mismatch for {name}: {tuple(tensor.shape)} != {tuple(expected)}")
+
+
+def is_m3_expert(name):
+    match = _LAYER.fullmatch(name)
+    return match is not None and _EXPERT.fullmatch(match[2]) is not None
+
+
+def export_m3_tensor(name, tensor, spec, *, expert_id_base=0):
+    """Yield public-checkpoint names and tensors; preserve dtype and orientation."""
+    if not tensor.is_floating_point():
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported non-floating M3 state tensor: {name}")
+    if name == "lm_head.weight":
+        yield "language_model.lm_head.weight", tensor
+        return
+    if name in ("model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight", "model.language_model.norm.weight"):
+        yield name.replace("model.language_model.", "language_model.model.", 1), tensor
+        return
+
+    match = _LAYER.fullmatch(name)
+    if match:
+        layer, suffix = int(match[1]), match[2]
+        if layer >= spec.layers:
+            raise ValueError(f"M3 layer {layer} is outside config depth {spec.layers}")
+        prefix = f"language_model.model.layers.{layer}."
+        expert = _EXPERT.fullmatch(suffix)
+        if expert:
+            if not spec.moe_layers[layer]:
+                raise ValueError(f"Expert tensor in configured dense layer: {name}")
+            count = tensor.shape[0]
+            if expert_id_base < 0 or expert_id_base + count > spec.experts:
+                raise ValueError(f"M3 expert range exceeds configured count: {name}")
+            dims = (
+                (2 * spec.intermediate, spec.hidden)
+                if expert[1] == "gate_up_proj"
+                else (spec.hidden, spec.intermediate)
+            )
+            _check_shape(name, tensor, (count, *dims))
+            for local_id, row in enumerate(tensor):
+                expert_prefix = f"{prefix}block_sparse_moe.experts.{expert_id_base + local_id}."
+                if expert[1] == "gate_up_proj":
+                    gate, up = row.chunk(2, dim=0)
+                    yield expert_prefix + "w1.weight", gate.contiguous()
+                    yield expert_prefix + "w3.weight", up.contiguous()
+                else:
+                    yield expert_prefix + "w2.weight", row.contiguous()
+            return
+        if suffix in ("mlp.gate.weight", "mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias"):
+            if not spec.moe_layers[layer]:
+                raise ValueError(f"Router tensor in configured dense layer: {name}")
+            out = (
+                "block_sparse_moe.gate.weight"
+                if suffix.endswith(".weight")
+                else ("block_sparse_moe.e_score_correction_bias")
+            )
+            expected = (spec.experts, spec.hidden) if suffix.endswith(".weight") else (spec.experts,)
+            _check_shape(name, tensor, expected)
+            yield prefix + out, tensor
+            return
+        dense = re.fullmatch(r"mlp\.(shared_experts\.)?(gate_up_proj|down_proj)\.weight", suffix)
+        if dense:
+            shared = dense[1] is not None
+            if shared != spec.moe_layers[layer]:
+                raise ValueError(f"MLP layout does not match M3 config: {name}")
+            intermediate = spec.shared_intermediate if shared else spec.dense_intermediate
+            out = "block_sparse_moe.shared_experts." if shared else "mlp."
+            if dense[2] == "gate_up_proj":
+                _check_shape(name, tensor, (2 * intermediate, spec.hidden))
+                gate, up = tensor.chunk(2, dim=0)
+                yield prefix + out + "gate_proj.weight", gate.contiguous()
+                yield prefix + out + "up_proj.weight", up.contiguous()
+            else:
+                _check_shape(name, tensor, (spec.hidden, intermediate))
+                yield prefix + out + "down_proj.weight", tensor
+            return
+        indexer = re.fullmatch(r"self_attn\.indexer\.([qk])_(proj|norm)\.weight", suffix)
+        if indexer:
+            yield prefix + f"self_attn.index_{indexer[1]}_{indexer[2]}.weight", tensor
+            return
+        if re.fullmatch(
+            r"(?:self_attn\.(?:[qkvo]_proj|[qk]_norm)|input_layernorm|post_attention_layernorm)\.(?:weight|bias)",
+            suffix,
+        ):
+            yield prefix + suffix, tensor
+            return
+        raise ValueError(f"Unmapped M3 language tensor: {name}")
+
+    if name.startswith("model.vision_tower."):
+        suffix = name.removeprefix("model.vision_tower.")
+        if suffix.startswith("layers."):
+            layer = int(suffix.split(".")[1])
+            if layer >= spec.vision_layers:
+                raise ValueError(f"M3 vision layer {layer} exceeds configured depth")
+            suffix = "encoder." + suffix
+        elif suffix == "embeddings.proj.weight":
+            suffix = "embeddings.patch_embedding.weight"
+        elif suffix not in ("pre_layrnorm.weight", "pre_layrnorm.bias"):
+            raise ValueError(f"Unmapped M3 vision tensor: {name}")
+        yield "vision_tower.vision_model." + suffix, tensor
+        return
+    projector = re.fullmatch(r"model\.multi_modal_projector\.(merge_)?linear_([12])\.(weight|bias)", name)
+    if projector:
+        prefix = "patch_merge_mlp" if projector[1] else "multi_modal_projector"
+        yield f"{prefix}.linear_{projector[2]}.{projector[3]}", tensor
+        return
+    raise ValueError(f"Unmapped M3 state tensor (MTP/quantized/other layout is unsupported): {name}")
+
+
+def iter_m3_param(name, tensor, spec, parallel_state):
+    """After FSDP gather, stream EP rows without gathering all experts at once.
+
+    A fresh receive row is used each time so previously yielded tensor views are
+    never overwritten by a later broadcast. FSDP still materializes one local
+    expert-stack parameter; sufficient memory/EP sharding is required for it.
+    """
+    if not is_m3_expert(name):
+        yield from export_m3_tensor(name, tensor, spec)
+        return
+    ep_size = parallel_state.ep_size if parallel_state.ep_enabled else 1
+    if ep_size < 1 or not 0 <= parallel_state.ep_rank < ep_size:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid M3 expert-parallel size or rank")
+    if spec.experts % ep_size:
+        raise ValueError("M3 expert count must divide evenly across training EP ranks")
+    count = spec.experts // ep_size
+    if tensor.ndim != 3 or tensor.shape[0] != count:
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected {count} local M3 experts after FSDP gather, got {tuple(tensor.shape)}")
+    if ep_size == 1:
+        yield from export_m3_tensor(name, tensor, spec)
+        return
+    for source in range(ep_size):
+        for row_id in range(count):
+            row = tensor[row_id].contiguous() if parallel_state.ep_rank == source else torch.empty_like(tensor[0])
+            dist.broadcast(row, group_src=source, group=parallel_state.ep_group)
+            yield from export_m3_tensor(name, row.unsqueeze(0), spec, expert_id_base=source * count + row_id)

+def minimax_m3_vl_collapse_image_tokens(prompt_ids: list[int], processor, num_images: int) -> list[int]:
+    """Restore one raw placeholder per image before vLLM expands MiniMax spans.
+
+    Unlike Qwen, vLLM MiniMax adds both vision boundary tokens itself. Keeping
+    the HF-expanded boundaries or pad run would change the inference prompt.
+    """
+    vocab = processor.tokenizer.get_vocab()
+    image_id = vocab["]<]image[>["]
+    start_id = vocab["]<]start of image[>["]
+    end_id = vocab["]<]end of image[>["]
+    result = []
+    image_count = 0
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(prompt_ids):
+        token_id = prompt_ids[i]
+        if token_id == start_id and i + 1 < len(prompt_ids) and prompt_ids[i + 1] == image_id:
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < len(prompt_ids) and prompt_ids[j] == image_id:
+                j += 1
+            if j == len(prompt_ids) or prompt_ids[j] != end_id:
+                raise ValueError("MiniMax image placeholder span is missing its end token")
+            result.append(image_id)
+            image_count += 1
+            i = j + 1
+            continue
+        result.append(token_id)
+        image_count += int(token_id == image_id)
+        i += 1
+    if image_count != num_images:
+        raise ValueError(f"MiniMax image placeholder count {image_count} does not match images {num_images}")
+    return result
+
